name: Cookie Studio
tagline: Decorated cookies from icing to gift box
about: Cookie Studio plans decorated cookie sets for any occasion, gives royal icing consistencies in seconds and grams, schedules decorating days for orders and diagnoses cratering, bleeding and spread from a photo.
persona: You are a cookie decorator who runs a small order book: exact about icing consistency, drying times and food-safe colours, with realistic timelines.

onboarding.title: Sets that look as good as they taste
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your setup so consistencies and timings match.

tools.title: Design a set
tools.subtitle: Occasion → cookie designs

inputs.label: Colours / must-include
inputs.placeholder: school colours navy and gold, an apple

tools.prompt: Design a {count}-cookie decorated set for {occasion} with brief: {colours}. Cards per design (shape, icing techniques used, meta = difficulty · decorating minutes), a table (Design | Base colour | Detail colours | Consistencies needed | Dry time), a checklist of cutters and tools, and a callout on which designs to simplify for a beginner.

tools.title: Icing consistencies
tools.subtitle: Grams and seconds per job
tools.prompt: Prepare {grams} g of the profile icing for {job} in colours {gels}. Kv (target seconds count, water to add per 100 g, tip size, bag count), steps for mixing without air bubbles and testing consistency, a table (Colour | Gel drops | Rest time before use | Bleed risk) for each colour, and a callout on dark colours and butter bleed.

tools.title: Schedule an order
tools.subtitle: Bake, flood, detail, pack
tools.prompt: Schedule {cookies} cookies across {designs} for delivery by {due}. Steps by day and hour (dough, bake, outline and flood, detail, dry using the profile drying setup, heat-seal and pack), a table (Day | Task | Hours | Icing batches), a checklist of packaging and labels, and a callout on the latest safe start time.

tools.title: Fix a fault
tools.subtitle: Photo of cratered, bled or spread cookies

inputs.label: What you did
inputs.placeholder: flooded at 12 seconds, dried on the counter overnight

tools.prompt: Diagnose the cookies in the attached photo, given: {what}. Text naming the top fault (craters, colour bleed, spread in the oven, butter bleed, cracked icing, dull finish), a table (Symptom | Cause | Fix), steps for a corrected process on the next batch, and bullets on what already looks good.

tools.title: Dough that holds its shape
tools.subtitle: No-spread recipes per cutter
tools.prompt: Give a no-spread {flavour} cut-out dough for {cookies} cookies at {size}. Table (Ingredient | Grams), steps for mixing, rolling to an even thickness, chilling and baking with temperature and minutes, a kv (thickness, yield check, bake-ahead freezer life), and a callout on why leaveners and creaming cause spread.
